a: A Promise represents a future value; use then/catch or async/await.
await pauses an async function until a Promise settles.
try/catch handles thrown errors in synchronous or awaited code.
JSON.parse turns a JSON string into an object; JSON.stringify does the reverse.
arr.filter(fn) returns items for which fn returns true.
arr.reduce((acc,x)=>..., init) folds a list into one value.
setTimeout(fn, ms) runs fn once after a delay.
setInterval(fn, ms) runs fn repeatedly until cleared.
export and import share values between ES modules.
=== compares value and type without coercion.
